prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were generally overly optimistic, though certain new flows and compact layouts outperformed expectations.
Reordering sign-in (sign_in, reorder) was helpful in 3 winning tests, though specific placements hurt or showed no clear effect.
Sign-in copy tweaks (sign_in, copy), finish hints (finish, hint), home hints (home, hint), and finish incentives (finish, incentive) showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Adding a new finish screen (finish, new_screen) hurt performance or showed no clear effect.
Home wait info changes (home, wait_info) were helpful in 1 winning test, while 3 tests showed no clear effect.
Evidence remains thin for change kinds tested only once, requiring at least 2 tests of that kind to state a rule.

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Spotlight Redesign: Redesign the pick_friend screen using a spotlight layout with focused pet visuals to make companion selection clearer and reduce drop-off. (why: Adoption step has the highest drop-off rate in onboarding (30.4% abandon) with a high median time of 89s.)
1: [choose_path, new_screen] Welcome Story Prologue Screen: Insert a short introductory prologue screen before the main story screen to give users context on what desktop companions do. (why: Choose path has high variance in time (mean 514s vs median 8s) and 23.9% drop-off, indicating early drop-offs need clearer context.)
2: [finish, new_flow] Home Intro Interactive Controls Flow: Add an interactive setup checklist component directly on the final intro screen to guide users through pet controls before finishing. (why: Support receives multiple inquiries after onboarding regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the pet (3 emails).)
3: [home, redesign] Waiting Screen Compact Stage Layout: Redesign the waiting screen layout to compact mode with an animated loading progress indicator. (why: The home waiting step has a long median completion time of 201s (mean 2336s) causing drop-offs before setup finishes.)
4: [sign_in, copy] Sign In Account Recovery Copy: Update sign-in headline and body to explicitly explain cloud pet backup benefits. (why: Top support issue is missing or reset pets after signing back in (8 emails).)
5: [choose_path, layout] Choose Path Card Layout Refresh: Change the choose_path screen layout to card format for clearer path presentation. (why: Choose path has a 23.9% drop-off rate and a high mean completion time of 514s.)
6: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Progress Time Estimate Info: Display explicit generation status body text and time estimate on the waiting screen. (why: Home step waiting time is long (median 201s, mean 2336s), causing uncertainty during pet model build.)
7: [finish, notification] Home Intro Desktop Ready Notification: Enable desktop notification toggle prompt on the final intro screen when pet setup completes. (why: 3 support tickets reported pet not showing up on desktop or app failing to open visibly after setup.)
8: [adoption, incentive] Adoption Certificate Badge Incentive: Add a verified companion badge component to the adoption certificate screen to celebrate completion. (why: Adoption step drop-off is 30.4%, so adding visual reward badges reinforces momentum before waiting.)
